text:
Amanda: Quick sync — AcmeHealth POC is greenlit but legal/proc needs a couple items before countersign:
- MSA + DPA redlines (they want customer KMS/HSM language)
- Order form needs explicit VPC/private deployment notes
- SLA ask: they want 99.95 -> we need to confirm fallback to 99.9 and document an exception
- PO flow: customer will send PO (Net30) but finance prefers Net45; need decision for this deal

Amanda: Adding folks: @Jane (Legal) @Li (Procurement) @Raj (Solutions) — who can own signature routing?

Jordan: I can prep the order form and populate fields. Which email should go on the countersign request? customer gave procurement@acmehealth.com

Jane (Legal): Quick Qs:
- For KMS/HSM: do they require specific certifications (FIPS 140-2/3)?
- Do they want key custody retained by them or a split custody model?
If they insist on customer-managed HSM and audit access, we'll need the addendum.
Suggested clause (short form):
```
Customer-managed KMS: Customer shall manage encryption keys in their approved HSM/KMS. Redwood will not retain key material and will provide access logs for audit on request. Any changes to key custody require written agreement.
```

Li (Procurement): Net30 ok if sales confirms. If finance needs Net45 we can raise an exception but need approver (VP Finance). Also need PO number format for invoicing. Please confirm whether tax/exemption applies.

Raj (Solutions): We will be delivering a Private deployment in a dedicated VPC. Need to add the following to the order form network section:
```
VPC: customer-managed VPC peering or VPN
Egress: restricted to listed IPs
KMS: customer-provided HSM (BYOK)
Support: Dedicated infra + 24x7 monitoring
```
Tim (Eng): Confirmed — KMS BYOK + HSM supported. For customer audit logs we can expose S3 logs + CloudTrail export. We do need the exact FIPS requirement to validate HSM model. Also note: if they want HSM on-prem, that becomes a deployment services line item.

SalesOps Bot: DocuSign envelope creation failed: `403: missing signer role` when attempting to add Countersigner set to procurement@acmehealth.com. Retry queued.

Jordan: SGTM — I'll rebuild the envelope and add the procurement signer as "Approver (Procurement)" instead of "Signer".

Amanda: Action items:
- @Jordan: update order form with VPC + KMS snippet and set Billing = Net30 for now (1723004444-PO placeholder)
- @Jane: draft the MSA addendum for customer-managed KMS + SLA exception language (99.9 fallback)
- @Li: confirm PO number and tax status; escalate to finance if Net45 needed
- @Raj/@Tim: capture the deployment SOW line items (HSM on-prem vs cloud HSM)
- @Jordan / SalesOps Bot: retry DocuSign with role change; if it fails, we'll route to manual signature (pdf + email)

Li (Procurement): FYI — procurement@acmehealth.com prefers a single PDF to attach to their internal PO system. If we can deliver a signed PDF + invoice that helps speed payment. :thumbsup:

Jane (Legal): I'll post a short redline and target to have the addendum ready by EOD PST. If they insist on HSM certification we may need legal signoff on the technical spec.

Amanda: Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker ping me directly. Trying to keep this POC on a single sign-off path so finance doesn't re-open terms.

Jordan: Re: envelope failure — manual fallback prepared: attach `acme_acmehealth_orderform_1723004444.pdf` and route to legal@redwood.com then procurement@acmehealth.com.

SalesOps Bot: Manual envelope option created: ID env-1723004444-manual. Please confirm when uploaded.

Amanda: Uploaded the PDF to the thread. Dropping checklist here for quick run:
- [ ] Order form updated (Jordan)
- [ ] MSA addendum (Jane)
- [ ] PO + tax confirmed (Li)
- [ ] SOW technical lines (Raj/Tim)
- [ ] Envelope retry or manual sign (Jordan/SalesOps Bot)

Amanda: Thanks team — aiming to have signed docs by EOD tomorrow.
